results.remarks:
Welcome to a masterfully restored Spanish-style sanctuary in the View Park neighborhood, where old-world charm seamlessly blends with contemporary convenience. This special home greets you with an inviting terracotta-tiled front porch, perfect for sipping your morning coffee in the sun. Step into the expansive living room, bathed in natural light and rich with character, featuring a classic fireplace adorned with vintage Batchelder tile.

The heart of the home is a chef’s dream kitchen, boasting custom cabinetry, quartzite countertops, designer backsplash tile, and brand-new appliances to elevate your culinary experience. The second floor offers two light-filled primary suites, each with luxurious retreat-style bathrooms and modern lighting. Two additional bedrooms on the first floor provide versatility and ample space, sharing a beautifully appointed second bathroom with custom tile finishes.

The backyard is an entertainer’s paradise, offering multiple options for hosting, with fresh landscaping and a large deck ideal for al fresco dining or twilight gatherings. The two-car garage provides coveted bonus space, perfect for a gym, home office, or potential ADU conversion. Ample parking is available in the driveway, with room both in front of and behind the gated entry.

Additional improvements include updated plumbing and electrical systems, a new roof, new driveway, new HVAC, and new windows.

Enjoy close proximity to Downtown Los Angeles, Leimert Park Village, SoFi Stadium, Downtown Culver City, Playa Vista, West Adams, and one of LA’s most beloved green spaces, Kenneth Hahn Park. You’re also near local favorites such as Jon & Vinny’s, Helen’s Wines, Hilltop Coffee + Kitchen, Simply Wholesome, the Culver City Stairs, and more. This exceptional home has been waiting for you and is truly a must-see to appreciate!

results.remarks: Located adjacent to the Westchester Golf Course on a non-through street with greenbelt views, this delightful home with vibrant landscaping is ideal for those who desire space and functionality. Past the canopy of the graceful California pepper tree step into an inviting living room featuring luxury vinyl plank flooring and custom fireplace with decorative stonework and zebrawood mantel. The modern kitchen anchored by a central island with breakfast bar features sleek quartz countertops, stylish tile backsplash, and stainless-steel appliances. 4 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms are downstairs, while upstairs is a private ensuite with wrap-around balcony...perfect for relaxing or enjoying the summer weather. Having multiple bedrooms allows flexibility for usage such as a home office, gym, guest suite, study, or playroom. The enchanting fully-enclosed backyard boasts a variety of plants and trees, as well as a separate fruit and vegetable garden. The privacy and versatility is ideal for entertaining, al fresco dining, gardening, or a playground for your pet(s). Additional highlights include copper plumbing, tankless water heater, soundproof windows with custom treatments, automatic sprinklers, and 2-car garage with an extra-long driveway. With easy access to beaches, LAX, and numerous shopping, dining, and entertainment destinations, this is an exceptional find in Westchester.

results.remarks: Positioned on the top floor just moments from iconic Melrose Place, this sophisticated two-bedroom, two-bath residence offers approximately 1,800 square feet of contemporary living across two levels, crowned by a private deck with sweeping city views. Wide-plank hardwood floors flow throughout the thoughtfully designed interiors, where an open-concept kitchen serves as the centerpiece of the main living space. Sleek Snaidero cabinetry in rich lead resin and matte grey finishes is complemented by Caesarstone countertops and a premium Sub-Zero and Wolf appliance package, creating a polished setting equally suited to everyday living and entertaining. Just moments from the boutiques, cafs, restaurants, and celebrated Sunday farmers market of Melrose Place, this is a rare opportunity to experience elevated, turnkey living at the center of one of Los Angeles' most dynamic neighborhoods.

results.remarks:
Experience contemporary West Los Angeles living in this stunning, designer-inspired townhome nestled within an intimate four-residence gated community. Built in 2013, this spacious 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers approximately 1,810 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space featuring soaring 10-foot ceilings, rich hardwood floors, and an open-concept floor plan filled with natural light.

The inviting living room is anchored by a striking floor-to-ceiling Porcelanosa-tiled fireplace, flowing seamlessly into the dining area and gourmet kitchen. Designed for both everyday living and entertaining, the kitchen showcases sleek European-style cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and generous prep space.

Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite offers a spa-inspired bathroom complete with dual vanities, a soaking tub, and a separate glass-enclosed shower. Two additional well-appointed bedrooms provide flexibility for family, guests, or a home office.
Additional highlights include central heating and air conditioning, in-unit laundry, oversized 8-foot interior doors, abundant storage, and direct access to a secure subterranean gated garage with two parking spaces.

Ideally situated in the heart of West Los Angeles, just moments from Sawtelle’s renowned restaurants, Brentwood, Santa Monica, UCLA, Century City, and convenient access to the 10 and 405 freeways, this exceptional residence offers the perfect blend of modern luxury, comfort, and location.

results.remarks: Welcome to Residence 411 at The Broadway Hollywood, a landmark residence that blends historic Old Hollywood character with modern luxury. Located within the desirable Streamline Moderne wing of the building, this expansive 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence features a rare private outdoor patio and soaring 12-foot ceilings. Offered fully furnished, the residence includes a curated collection of high-end designer furnishings, all included in the purchase price, creating a truly turnkey opportunity for the next owner.Currently configured as an open-concept loft, the residence offers exceptional volume and natural light. The original second bedroom was opened by a prior owner to create additional living space and can be reconfigured by a future owner, subject to their preferences and any applicable HOA approvals. results.remarks: Perched on a peaceful hillside in the highly sought-after Westchester neighborhood of Los Angeles, this beautifully remodeled residence blends timeless California elegance with thoughtful modern design. Inspired by the iconic Shutters on the Beach aesthetic, every detail has been carefully curated to create a warm, sophisticated retreat just minutes from Silicon Beach, Playa Vista, Marina del Rey, LAX, and some of Southern California's most desirable beaches. Recently refreshed with new interior and exterior paint, the home welcomes you with newly refinished French oak hardwood floors, abundant natural light, and custom millwork throughout. Two spacious living areas provide exceptional flexibility for everyday living and entertaining, each illuminated by expansive south-facing windows that fill the home with sunshine. The secondary living room features custom built-in cabinetry, while elegant molding and architectural details echo the refined coastal style found throughout the home. At the heart of the residence, the remodeled chef's kitchen seamlessly connects to the family room, creating an inviting open-concept living space. White custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a center island offer both beauty and functionality for gathering with family and friends. Designed with privacy in mind, the spacious primary suite occupies its own wing of the home, separated from the two secondary bedrooms. Vaulted shiplap ceilings create an airy, resort-inspired atmosphere, complemented by expansive custom built-in closets, including separate his-and-her closet spaces. The luxurious primary bathroom features marble tile flooring, a large glass-enclosed walk-in shower, extensive custom cabinetry, and premium finishes that deliver a true spa-like experience.Additional highlights include recessed lighting throughout, custom-built vanities and storage, an attached two-car garage with direct access and durable epoxy flooring, and exceptional craftsmanship evident in every room. Step outside to a generous backyard designed for both relaxation and entertaining. Enjoy a lush grassy lawn, hillside planters, and a covered outdoor entertaining area that offers the perfect setting for al fresco dining, weekend gatherings, or peaceful evenings under the California sky. Ideally located on a quiet residential street with convenient access to Playa Vista, Culver City, Marina del Rey, and major freeways, this exceptional Westchester-area home offers the perfect balance of tranquility, coastal living, and commuter convenience. Whether you're seeking proximity to major Silicon Beach employers including Google, YouTube, Apple, SpaceX, and Tesla, or easy access to world-class dining, shopping, recreation, and Los Angeles International Airport, this home delivers an unmatched lifestyle in one of Los Angeles' most desirable neighborhoods.

results.remarks: Tattuplex, 2012. Tom Marble, Architect. Published in "Dwell," "Los Angeles Times" and appears in the Sixth Edition of Gebhard and Winters' "An Architectural Guidebook to Los Angeles," where it is described  as a "remote hillside shrine." The two-level duplex was conceived through an ongoing conversation between architect Tom Marble and owner Tim Tattu. Its custom prefab steel-frame and concrete structure follows a double-hexagon plan, creating a natural flow through an otherwise complex geometry. The initial plan was pushed and pulled through multiple studies, reaching its final form 95 variations later. The result is a building that feels deeply rooted to its site. Rooms open onto terraces and wide, framed views of the surrounding landscape, while shifts in level create a sense of discovery throughout the house. That same attention extends to the interior. Much of the furniture is integral to the architecture: custom Douglas fir cabinetry, shelving, desks and storage were designed specifically for the house and its geometry. A sculptural dining table by Vincent Pocsik sits naturally within this language of custom furnishings. Artwork by Pae White, artist and partner of Tom Marble, adds another layer to a house shaped from its inception by architecture, art and design. In 2016, Tattuplex was awarded the best Small Multi-Family Residential Building Award by the AIA.  Initially designed to function as a multi-family residence, it can also function as a single-family compound depending on need. Nearly every major room opens to a view of the Silver Lake reservoir and the hills beyond. Many of the custom indoor and outdoor furnishings are being included with the sale.

Rare two-house compound in the coveted Franklin Hills pocket of Los Feliz. Situated on a 6,700 sq. ft. lot, this detached duplex offers privacy and income potential: a front house with 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, and a back house with 2 bedrooms, a bonus room and 1 bathroom. results.remarks: The Alvarado Lofts on Kingston Place are centrally located near trendy dining, boutiques and nightlife. Set behind a gated drive with ample parking for multiple vehicles, and framed by mature hedging, custom fencing, citrus trees, and terraced landscaping, the home feels distinctly removed from the city below while remaining moments from Eagle Rock's shops, restaurants, and neighborhood life. Thoughtfully renovated while preserving its original mid-century character, the home balances architectural integrity with modern livability. European oak hardwood floors, custom French doors, built-in library details, a sculptural stair banister, and a dramatic double-sided fireplace lend the interiors warmth, depth, and character. The remodeled kitchen and spa-inspired baths, appointed with Carrara marble tile and Hansgrohe fixtures, introduce a refined contemporary layer while remaining true to the home's design. The main level offers an open, connected layout designed for both everyday living and entertaining, complemented by a bedroom and full bath that provide flexibility for guests or a home office. Upstairs, two bedrooms capture sweeping hillside views, including a primary with a custom-designed walk-in closet, and a full bath. Beyond the visible finishes, the property has been meaningfully improved with a full roof replacement, dual-zone central air and heat, owned solar, an EV charger, whole-house water filtration, and prior copper plumbing and electrical upgrades. Outside, acclaimed landscape architect Christine London, whose work has been featured in Architectural Digest, designed an immersive hillside setting brought to life by Crestview Landscape. Expansive, multi-level patio decking, custom railings, terraced gardens, mature lemon, lime, and orange trees, a cedar soaking tub, outdoor fire pit, new irrigation, and custom landscape lighting create an immersive hillside setting equally suited to entertaining and quiet moments of retreat. Private, atmospheric, and thoughtfully renovated, this exceptional hillside residence embodies the very best of Eagle Rock living, where architectural character, panoramic views, and modern comfort come together in remarkable balance.

A spacious great room opens to a generous private deck through expansive 12-foot sliding glass doors, filling the space with natural light. White oak finishes throughout soften the contemporary aesthetic. The chef's kitchen features a full suite of appliances seamlessly integrated into paneled cabinetry, complemented by refined quartz countertops. The highly walkable neighborhood is home to beloved cafes, restaurants, and boutiques, with Sunset Junction, Atwater Village, Glendale, Downtown Los Angeles, and Hollywood all within a short drive. At the center of the home is a beautifully appointed chef's kitchen with quartz countertops, custom cabinetry, premium appliances, and an oversized island, perfect for gathering, entertaining, and everyday living. Expansive living and dining spaces open effortlessly to outdoor patio areas, creating multiple moments for connection and relaxation under the California sky.

The home offers 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms across a practical, well-balanced layout that combines comfort and flexibility. Downstairs, a flexible bonus room offers the perfect space for a home office, yoga studio, guest bedroom, or whatever the next chapter calls for. The primary suite features a large walk-in closet and a bathroom remodeled to perfection with luxury in mind, creating a private sanctuary.

Outside, the fully fenced backyard provides room for kids to play and pets to roam freely. Thoughtful upgrades throughout include central HVAC, double-pane windows, in-home laundry, generous storage, and an attached direct-access garage with additional off-street parking. Set on a beautifully positioned hillside lot with neighborhood views, the outdoor spaces feel both private and connected to the surrounding landscape.

Clean architectural lines and curated finishes deliver a rare turnkey opportunity that feels refined without sacrificing warmth or livability. The home is also zoned for the highly regarded Delevan Elementary School. Located in one of Northeast LA's most sought-after neighborhoods, the property sits close to Colorado Boulevard's celebrated cafes, restaurants, and boutiques, with convenient access to Pasadena, Highland Park, Glendale, and Downtown Los Angeles. A rare blend of thoughtful upgrades, modern comfort, hillside character, and top-rated schools in the heart of Eagle Rock.

Every element has been envisioned to enhance life at the highest level. The Park Elm Residences at Century Plaza is more than a home; it is an architectural landmark and an enduring expression of modern elegance just moments away from the best shopping, dining, and lifestyle Century City has to offer.

results.remarks: Set within the architectural character of Historic Country Club Park HPOZ, 1138 S Andrews Pl offers a rare proposition: the timeless presence of a traditional Los Angeles bungalow paired with the comfort, efficiency, and modern finishes of a residence built new in 2014. Thoughtfully composed across four bedrooms and two baths, the home delivers a sense of quiet sophistication rather than excess. Classic bungalow proportions create warmth and familiarity, while contemporary materials, clean finishes, and a more modern approach to everyday living provide the refinement expected by today's discerning buyer. The result is a residence that feels established in its surroundings yet distinctly current. Privacy and tranquility are central to the experience. Country Club Park is prized for its residential streets, architectural continuity, and strong sense of neighborhood, creating a welcome separation from the pace of the city while keeping Los Angeles remarkably accessible. The 90019 location is equally compelling. Positioned between the Westside and Downtown, the property places Beverly Hills, Culver City, Koreatown, Downtown Los Angeles, and the Miracle Mile cultural corridor within convenient reach. Spend the morning at a neighborhood caf, an afternoon exploring Los Angeles' renowned museums and galleries and the evening dining or shopping at The Grove and Original Farmers Market, all without surrendering the comfort of a residential enclave. For the buyer who values architecture, privacy, centrality, and a lifestyle shaped by both culture and convenience, 1138 S Andrews Pl represents a particularly well-balanced Los Angeles offering.

results.remarks: Life at the W Residences isn't just about where you live, it's about how you live. Set high above the iconic streets in the heart of Hollywood, this turnkey designer penthouse is where modern luxury, energy, and creativity come together in a way few addresses can match. Ideally situated in the building for privacy, mornings in this corner unit begin with sunlight pouring through walls of glass, revealing a skyline that stretches effortlessly from Downtown Los Angeles to Century City. A fully integrated Control4 system and home automation allow you to create just the right mood with the touch of a button -- lighting, music, and solar and blackout shades all work together to create the perfect vibe for throwing a soiree or enjoying a quiet evening at home. The kitchen, outfitted with sleek Poliform cabinetry and top tier Sub-Zero and Miele appliances, is as refined as it is functional -- equally suited for quiet mornings or gourmet dinners. When it's time to slow down, the residence transforms into a private retreat. A hidden screen in the living room descends to create a true in-home theater experience, while the primary bedroom suite offers a calm, ambient escape with soft perimeter LED lighting. The primary bath evokes a spa-like feel, layered with warm lighting that make every evening wind-down feel intentional.  A private terrace with endless city views is the perfect place for a night cap or cocktails with friends. Living at the W Hollywood Residences means access to amazing amenities and services including one of the best rooftop pools and hot tubs in LA surrounded by cabanas, outdoor grills for dining al fresco and state-of-the-art fitness center. Residents enjoy 24-hour concierge and valet, two side-by-side parking spots, rooftop dog park, and housekeeping services, all delivered with the ease and polish of hotel/residence living. Step outside and you're immediately immersed in the best of Hollywood  Pantages Theater and Katsuya across the street, Tao just a few blocks away, Trader Joe's and Bristol Farms just steps outside, and the W Hotel bar and restaurant an elevator ride away. This is more than a penthouse. It's your backstage pass to the rhythm and glamour of Hollywood, elevated, refined, and entirely your own.

Living, dining, and kitchen spaces flow seamlessly onto a sky-lounge terrace overlooking the grounds below. More than 3,000 square feet of outdoor living space unfold across landscaped terraces, featuring a solar-heated pool, terrace spa, fireside lounges, and a yard with a bocce ball court. Lush greenery surrounds distinct spaces to gather, unwind, and take in the panoramic setting. Upstairs, the loft-style primary bedroom captures striking city vistas, complemented by a second bedroom and full bath. A legal ADU with its own separate entrance and private rooftop patio adds exceptional flexibility to the property. Complete with a bedroom, private bath, and dedicated workspace, it can function independently as guest accommodations or serve as an extension of the main residence. Envision a home office, gym, pool house, in-law suite, recording studio, art space, or private retreat.With its distinctive architecture, commanding 180-degree views, corner-lot setting, and generous spaces for entertaining, The Hollywood Jetliner offers an inspired environment for living, working, and hosting in the Hollywood Hills, within easy reach of the Sunset Strip's dining, shopping, and nightlife. Truly an exceptional architectural offering in one of Los Angeles' most iconic hillside settings.

results.remarks: Behind the red door lies an unexpected Ladera Heights retreat - beautifully remodeled, completely single-level, and designed around the way Southern California was meant to be lived. Remodeled in 2017, this 4-bedroom, 3-bath residence combines warm contemporary design with exceptional indoor-outdoor living. Wide-plank oak hardwood floors flow through a dramatic open living space where soaring vaulted ceilings and four skylights fill the home with natural light. Expansive accordion doors open the living area to the backyard, allowing the indoors and outdoors to become one effortless entertaining space. At the heart of the home is a kitchen made for people who truly love to cook and gather. A substantial quartz island offers storage on both sides, while JennAir appliances include a six-burner range with pot filler, double-door refrigerator, dishwasher, wine refrigerator, dedicated wine storage, and an impressive three ovens, including convection. The private primary retreat features vaulted ceilings, direct backyard access, a generous walk-in closet, and a spa-inspired bath finished with quartz surfaces and marble flooring. A separate soaking tub, rainfall shower with handheld fixture, and linen storage complete the space. Outside is where this home becomes something truly special. The private edible garden is filled with peach, nectarine, plum, Meyer lemon, avocado, lime, blood orange, navel orange, strawberry guava, and mango trees, along with fragrant rosemary. Sprinkler and drip irrigation systems help maintain the lush landscape. Gather around the gas fire pit with built-in seating, cook beneath the pergola at the quartz-topped outdoor kitchen with BBQ, Green Egg, and dedicated gas plumbing, or enjoy the turf, play area, outdoor gas fireplace, and remarkable privacy. Additional features include central air and heat, two tankless water heaters, a dedicated laundry area, marble bathroom floors, and a semi-circular driveway leading to a welcoming front porch. Ideally situated in coveted Ladera Heights, the home offers convenient access to Culver City, Playa Vista, Westfield Culver City, LAX, LMU, Marina del Rey, SoFi Stadium, Intuit Dome, YouTube Theater, and the best of the Westside and Inglewood. Beautifully considered from the skylights above to the garden outside, this is a home designed not simply to be seen, but to be lived in. Some homes are impressive. This one is unforgettable.

Thoughtfully renovated while honoring its architectural roots, this exceptional residence offers timeless design, quality craftsmanship, and an effortless indoor-outdoor lifestyle and nearby celebrated restaurants, cafés, boutiques, and neighborhood parks.

results.remarks: Rare Penthouse live/work loft at Barker Block in the Arts District with stunning DTLA views. With 16 ft high windows with unobstructed city views, this unit provides an unparalleled living experience and could also be utilized as a unique work space. Custom built-in cabinets & bookshelves, hardwood floors throughout, a unique mirrored wall, century-old wood posts & beams and heavy timber ceilings reaching approx 21 ft. The central piece of this space is the open gourmet kitchen w/ SS appliances & Caesarstone countertops, large pantry, and comes with plenty of storage. There are also 2 large bathrooms, one with a built-in washer/ dryer unit. Since this space is a L-shaped floor plan, many lay-outs are possible. Adding a mezzanine is one of those possibilities as well and could create additional live/work space.The building features 24/7 security and front desk, free common area wifi, outdoor lounge with firepit, a stunning resort-style rooftop heated pool with spa and BBQ areas. The fitness center can also be found on the rooftop and provides a working out experience with the best DTLA views! The unit comes with 2 covered parking spaces conveniently located on the fifth floor as well as a storage unit. Lastly the location provides one of the (if not the) best experiences of living in the Arts District. Across from Urth Caffe, the Arts District Park & the LA Cleantech Incubator. It is a short distance to SCIArc, Little Tokyo, Goldline, DASH bus, Zinc Cafe, Urban Radish, Verve cafe, the local dog park and more. Close to public transit and freeways. It's the best of two worlds colliding in a very stylish penthouse unit. Come see for yourself.

Nestled in the heart of charming Atwater Village, this beautifully updated one-story front-and-back duplex offers the perfect blend of timeless character and modern convenience. Behind a gated entrance, you’ll find garage parking, thoughtful upgrades, a newer electrical panel, central air conditioning, and the kind of pride of ownership that’s evident throughout.

To say this property has all the right amenities while preserving its original charm would be an understatement. The floor plans are highly functional, creating comfortable living spaces that feel both warm and inviting.

Living in Atwater Village means enjoying one of Los Angeles’ most desirable neighborhoods. Just moments away are the vibrant restaurants, cafés, boutiques, and neighborhood favorites along Hillhurst Avenue and Vermont Avenue. Spend weekends exploring the iconic Griffith Park, home to miles of hiking and horseback riding trails, the Griffith Observatory, the Greek Theatre, and the world-famous Los Angeles Zoo.

Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the nearby Hollywood Hills and Santa Monica Mountains views, offering easy access to scenic hiking, cycling, and breathtaking sunsets. The neighborhood is also rich in architectural history, classic homes, and a walkable village atmosphere that blends urban convenience with a true sense of community.

With easy access to Downtown Los Angeles, Hollywood, Silver Lake, Los Feliz, and major freeways, this location provides exceptional convenience while maintaining the peaceful charm that has made Atwater Village one of the city’s most treasured neighborhoods.

Whether you’re looking for an owner-user opportunity, multi-generational living, or an exceptional investment, this sophisticated property offers the rare combination of classic Los Angeles character, tasteful modern updates, and an unbeatable location in one of the city’s most beloved neighborhoods.

results.remarks: Perched in the coveted hills of Los Feliz, this enchanting 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom residence blends timeless character with distinctive old-world charm. Rich in architectural detail, the home welcomes you with striking wrought-iron accents, dramatic arched doorways, textured plaster walls, exposed wood-beamed ceilings, and expansive picture windows that fill the interiors with natural light while framing serene hillside vistas. The spacious living room is anchored by a decorative fireplace and showcases elegant oversized arched windows, creating a warm and inviting setting for both relaxing and entertaining. A charming formal dining area flows into the character-filled kitchen featuring custom cabinetry, open shelving, vintage-inspired details, and a cozy breakfast nook. Throughout the home, unique design elements and thoughtfully preserved finishes create an authentic sense of style rarely found today. Outside, lush mature landscaping surrounds the property, offering privacy and a tranquil retreat just moments from the vibrant shops, dining, and cultural attractions that make Los Feliz one of Los Angeles' most sought-after neighborhoods. This is a rare opportunity to own a truly distinctive hillside home brimming with charm, character, and endless potential.

results.remarks: A light-filled jewel box in Brentwood, this penthouse offers a rare combination of space, style, and privacy. Spanning approximately 1,732 square feet, the residence offers 3 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, a spacious and functional floor plan, wood floors, abundant closet space, and a side-by-side washer and dryer. Walk into a large, bright, and peaceful living and dining space with a gas fireplace anchoring the room. Three east-facing balconies welcome beautiful morning light and neighborhood views, while creating bright, airy living spaces and an effortless indoor-outdoor connection. Large exposures in each bedroom capture top floor sunlight and treetop vistas. The 3rd bedroom, currently set up as an office, features functional built-ins/library for displaying keepsakes. Additional highlights include two-car secured parking, a private locked storage area, and elevator access in a well-maintained, secure building. The complex was built in 2000, has just 14 units, includes guest parking, and is exceptionally well maintained with external management in place. Ideally located north of Wilshire in Brentwood, around the corner from cafe favorites Amandine and Literati, and minutes from grocery stores Erewhon, Bristol Farms and Ralphs. Period mid-century decor completes the aesthetic of this wonderful home.

results.remarks: Set on a double lot. Hidden behind an unassuming gate and tucked below the street, this enchanting two-story retreat embodies iconic Laurel Canyon living offering exceptional privacy, tranquility, and sweeping west-facing views with unforgettable sunsets. A descending pathway leads to a secluded oasis that feels worlds away, yet remains moments from the famed Canyon Country Store, the Sunset Strip, and easy access to the San Fernando Valley.  Completed in 2025 with long-term living in mind, this 1,737 sq. ft. home reflects a comprehensive renovation focused on meaningful improvements rather than superficial updates. Thoughtfully updated while preserving the natural charm of its Laurel Canyon setting, the home represents significant investment in both design and underlying systems. The upstairs is currently configured with two bedrooms, two separate office spaces, and one full bathroom, with an additional walk-in closet adjacent to the primary bedroom. The flexible office spaces are ideal for working from home, creative use, or other flex-space needs. The layout downstairs was reworked to create a more open, cohesive flow. The kitchen, once enclosed, is now a bright, open-plan space centered around a newly added island, designed for everyday living and entertaining. rebuilt with new cabinetry, quartz countertops, and a complete suite of new appliances. A pot filler faucet, brass hardware, curated lighting, and Portola Roman Clay finishes add warmth and texture. The upstairs bathroom was fully renovated with new tile, tub, vanity, and fixtures, along with an integrated bidet toilet. A stylish powder room was added downstairs, featuring checkered tile, a new vanity, and a dedicated laundry area. Refreshed decking, a rebuilt trellis, and curated landscaping enhance the outdoor areas. Set on a rare double lot totaling approximately 8,805 sq. ft., the property offers exceptional space, privacy, and future expansion potential. A true creative sanctuary immersed in nature, located within the coveted Wonderland Avenue Elementary School district. Property includes two APNs: 5556-004-031 and 5556-009-013.

results.remarks:
Tucked into one of Leimert Park's most inviting streets, this 3 bedroom, 2 bath home blends 1930s character with a thoughtful, high end remodel. Olive trees and white rose bushes frame the entry, setting the tone before you even step inside.

The formal living room anchors the home with exposed wood beams, wide plank French Oak floors, and a fireplace that gives the space real warmth. From there, the layout flows naturally into a separate family room, complete with its own wood burning fireplace and direct backyard access, a layout upgrade that's genuinely hard to find on this block.

The kitchen was clearly built for someone who actually cooks. An 8 foot island topped in porcelain, custom cabinetry, Rejuvenation hardware, a Thermador six burner range, and a dedicated exhaust hood. The adjoining dining area comfortably fits a table for ten.

The primary suite includes a designer en suite bath and two separate walk in closets. The two secondary bedrooms share a bathroom finished with Pottery Barn fixtures and Bedrosian tile, plus built in cabinetry for extra storage. A mudroom off the kitchen houses the pantry and stacked laundry, leading out to a wide, grassy backyard with hardscaped areas for entertaining.

Out back, a detached two car garage with an attached shed adds real flexibility. Plenty of room to store, work, or explore future ADU potential. An automatic gate secures the driveway for privacy.

Location wise, you're minutes from the Metro line and the 10 freeway, close to neighborhood parks, and a short drive from the beach, all while sitting in one of LA's most storied and tight knit communities.

results.remarks: Set in the Silver Lake hills, this architectural three-bed, three-bath residence pairs sweeping city views with warm contemporary finishes, abundant natural light, and exceptional indoor/outdoor living. Built in 2022 and one of only five single-family homes in a tranquil architectural community, the residence is oriented to capture more than 180 degrees of panoramic views across the Silver Lake Reservoir, Downtown Los Angeles, the Griffith Park Observatory, and surrounding hillsides. Soaring ceilings, dramatic walls of glass, thoughtfully landscaped grounds, a generous primary suite with private balcony, an expansive rooftop deck, and an oversized direct-entry two-car garage create a private hillside retreat in the heart of Silver Lake. A pedestrian gate at the rear of the property on Waverly opens to beautifully landscaped grounds, creating a lush and private approach to the home. A full wall of glass introduces the main living level, where a convenient powder room is tucked just off the foyer before soaring ceilings and generous proportions give way to distinct living and dining areas. The beautifully appointed kitchen features a large eat-in island, abundant cabinetry, and Bertazzoni appliances, while oversized sliding glass doors open to a private wraparound patio, extending the living spaces outdoors and framing views of the garden and city beyond. An oversized two-car garage provides an additional point of entry with direct access into the residence, along with a designated laundry area and generous storage. The bedroom level features all three bedrooms and two bathrooms, creating a comfortable separation from the main entertaining spaces. The spacious primary suite includes a large walk-in closet, a private balcony overlooking the landscaped grounds, and an ensuite bathroom with dual vanities and a glass-enclosed shower positioned to take in the view. Two additional bedrooms offer flexibility for family, guests, or a home office. Above, an expansive rooftop deck provides a standout setting for outdoor dining, lounging, and entertaining, with panoramic vistas stretching across the Silver Lake Reservoir toward Downtown Los Angeles. Additional features include a designated laundry area, generous storage, a direct-entry garage, and multiple landscaped outdoor spaces that connect the home to its hillside surroundings. Ideally located near the restaurants, cafes, and shops along Hyperion and Rowena Avenues, including neighborhood favorites such as Blair's, Makisupa, Edendale, and Broome Street General Store, the home is also convenient to the Silver Lake Reservoir, Griffith Park, and Ivanhoe Elementary School. With expansive views, generous outdoor spaces, and a private architectural setting, this modern residence captures the best of hillside living in Silver Lake.
